title: Dynamic Smart Mining network: auto-rotates across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), prioritizing reserve deficits and tool match
note: Policy-driven autonomous Mining runner governed by game/mine-policy.json (Zero/Unity). Matches fitted tools (mining laser, ice harvester, gas harvester), prioritizes needs.tsv/supply_chains deficits while skipping full reserves, enforces live 15% regrowth floor in flight with instant cooldown rotation, and caps <=3 ships/belt atomically. 2026-11-24 14:51 UTC (Zero): max_ships 90 -> 3 and requires.empire voidborn: a test of three before any lift (F37). mine_net.py read no field since its launch (the stations query named columns read.db lacks; fixed by fleet-build the same turn), so every run rested without mining; the policy deposits only at the five home stations where give routes of ours collect (deposit_stations). 2026-11-24 15:20 UTC (Zero): max_ships 3 -> 9 and requires.empire dropped: the first run claimed an iron belt at once (GSC-0027 Spacetime Seep, store at Node Beta) after the fix; Nebula and Solarian stations with give routes joined the deposit list, and the plan's own belts are excluded, so it works only belts no static route holds; six miners waited with every static belt at 3. 2026-11-24 15:21 UTC (Zero): max_ships 9 -> 6: a dry run found no belt for the pilots at Grand Exchange (the region's iron belts are the plan's own or under 15 percent), so six until its runs show where it finds work. 2026-11-24 18:16 UTC (Zero): max_ships 6 -> 9: five runs read (260 to 390 ore a run, 46 to 50 minutes, -312 to -391 cr, runs.jsonl 15:05 to 16:23 UTC), no loss; three Voidborn veterans waited with no open work (fill status 17:35 UTC) while the policy opens iron in atlas and intercrus (three free belts, nine places at three a belt).
